# Console Review Checklist: Operations Console

**Purpose**: Requirements-quality review of the mode switch, the deep link, the console's reduction
and the sync operation, for the reviewer at Gate 2 (plan review)
**Created**: 2026-11-21
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md), [plan.md](../plan.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Mode

- [ ] CHK001 - Is it specified how soon the web app follows a change of `ADLC_BOARD_ENABLED` (the API's restart plus the 60 s re-read), and is that acceptable as the fallback path? [Clarity, Spec §US4, research R-01]
- [ ] CHK002 - Is the behaviour defined for a person with a page open while the mode changes (the next re-read switches the sidebar; an open decision form is refused by nothing, since the API keeps every command)? [Coverage, Spec §FR-009]
- [ ] CHK003 - Is the API-error fallback (keep the last mode, else inbox) consistent with SC-002 ("no page offers a decision in console mode")? [Consistency, Spec §US4-3, §SC-002]

## Deep link and run page

- [ ] CHK004 - Is the evidence link's form fixed (`…/?run=<id>`, 016's setting) and is the route for it independent of which page is the default? [Clarity, Spec §FR-001, research R-04]
- [ ] CHK005 - Is artifact editing in console mode bounded to runs awaiting the person's sign-off, as in 007, so the console does not become a second place to change outcomes? [Consistency, Spec §FR-002]
- [ ] CHK006 - Is "the board's address for browsers" defined with its default and its use for every link (run, clarification, use case)? [Completeness, Spec §FR-011, research R-03]

## Reduction

- [ ] CHK007 - Is the list of console pages closed, and is the default page named? [Clarity, Spec §FR-007, research R-05]
- [ ] CHK008 - Is the Dead letters page's re-queue (007, platform outbox) distinguished from the sync status re-queue (016, board delivery) so the CoE knows which is which? [Ambiguity, Spec §US2-4]
- [ ] CHK009 - Is SC-002's sweep defined (every registered page, the controls that count as "offering a decision")? [Measurability, Spec §SC-002]

## Sync operation

- [ ] CHK010 - Is "Reconcile now" specified with a confirmation and with what happens while one is running? [Completeness, Spec §FR-005, Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK011 - Is the compose change (the API gets the board settings) recorded as a fix of 016's deployment, with the same values as the board service? [Traceability, research R-02]

## Notes

- `/speckit-implement` reads checklist state but does not modify markers.
